name: Dot interpretation and accessibility
text:
Dots remain filled while pulsing; motion is shown statically here. With reduced
                motion, keep them still. Tooltip and accessible text announce the exact state when
                colors are shared. The dot must match the task-details status, not the PR/issue
                badge or trailing unread dot.

name: Reference precedence
text:
The badge row contains the linked PR and issue numbers. Use distinct PR/issue glyphs;
              show both when both exist. Tracker status stays separate from the task attention dot.
style: box-sizing: border-box; color: #4B5566; font-family: Poppins, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-style: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: 0px; line-height: 18px; text-align: left; width: 100%

name: Responsive behavior
text:
Filled task dots align with the first title line. The second row is for PR/issue badges
          only. Status names are available through tooltips and accessible descriptions. Worker
          indentation is 20px. Pinned tasks retain an accent pin; unpinned tasks expose Pin on
          hover/focus or in the task menu.

                badge or trailing unread dot.

            menu.
